rationale: The first integration was correct but measured 0.001566 s, slower than the correct T1 base at 0.000888 s. Return to the faster T1 tiled kernel and test the T3 arithmetic idea as a separate experiment: accumulate acceleration directly, cancel the positive target mass algebraically, and use rsqrtf(distSq) cubed instead of sqrtf plus division. T3 itself failed generation, so its proposal is only an unverified idea, not a verified input. Preserve T1's launch and source tiling to isolate the arithmetic change. Recompile and run all correctness checks before measuring; retain the faster verified candidate if this change fails or regresses.
